description: Mobile responsiveness fixes for SkillGapItem and CertificateCard, plus adding missing difficultTopics/interviewStage/selfAssessment fields to InterviewLog model. All other components audited and confirmed already responsive. This completes the 57-task master plan.
steps: Edit frontend/src/components/career/SkillGapItem.jsx: On the outer flex div (contains rank badge, skill name, priority badge, and learningEffort badge), change class from 'flex items-center gap-3' to 'flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-start gap-2'. Wrap the two trailing badge spans (priority and learningEffort) together in a new div with class 'flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap' so they group neatly on all screen sizes.

Edit frontend/src/components/career/CertificateCard.jsx: On the div at line ~41 that contains the date span and status badge (class 'flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap'), change to 'flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center gap-2 flex-wrap'. This prevents the badge from overflowing on 375px screens.

Edit backend/models/InterviewLog.js: After the 'outcome' field definition and before the closing brace of interviewLogSchema's fields object, add three new optional fields: difficultTopics: { type: [String], default: [] }, interviewStage: { type: String, default: '' }, selfAssessment: { type: String, default: '' }. These fields are accessed by interviewLogController.js:getInterviewLearning (log.difficultTopics || []) — without them the Interview Weak Areas feature always returns empty.
Run cd frontend && npm run build to verify the frontend compiles without errors.
Run cd backend && node --check models/InterviewLog.js to verify no syntax errors in the model.
Commit all changes with message: 'feat: FEAT-005 mobile responsiveness + InterviewLog missing fields'.
acceptance_criteria: SkillGapItem renders priority and effort badges on a new line below the skill name at 375px viewport width, with no horizontal overflow.
CertificateCard shows date and status badge stacking vertically on small screens.
InterviewLog.js schema contains difficultTopics ([String]), interviewStage (String), and selfAssessment (String) fields.
cd frontend && npm run build exits with code 0.
cd backend && node --check models/InterviewLog.js exits with code 0.

No other components (SkillEvidenceHub, CareerActionPlan, InternshipReadiness, DigitalPassport, ApplicationOutcomes, Applications, CompletionWorkflow, CertificateVerification) were modified — they are already responsive.
